verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is documented as a terminal coding agent: it opens a full-screen TUI that reads the codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests and presents a diff. It also offers a `byteask exec` headless mode, sandbox and approval flags, and a documented CLI reference, and the runtime probes confirm the docs describe an agent 'that runs in your terminal'. It also supports self-hosted OpenAI-compatible models. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a local terminal run (all evidence is vendor-authored), and explicit install steps in the evidence.
